help:
usage: outlook-cli [-h] [--json] [--table] [--no-spinner] [--account ACCOUNT]
                   {account,draft,mail,task,cal,contact,teams,mailbox,auth,files,copilot,signature,gateway,config,mcp,completion} ...

Manage Outlook mail, drafts, calendar, contacts, and Teams chats

positional arguments:
  {account,draft,mail,task,cal,contact,teams,mailbox,auth,files,copilot,signature,gateway,config,mcp,completion}
    account             Manage account profiles
    draft               Manage email drafts
    mail                Read and search emails
    task                Manage tasks
    cal                 Manage calendar events
    contact             Manage contacts
    teams               Browse Teams chats and messages
    mailbox             Manage mailbox settings
    auth                Manage authentication
    files               Browse and manage OneDrive and SharePoint files
    copilot             Ask Microsoft 365 Copilot (internal API, can change)
    signature           Manage email signatures
    gateway             Teams-to-pi gateway daemon
    config              Inspect local configuration
    mcp                 Run the MCP server on stdio (no send tools)
    completion          Print a shell completion script

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                Output machine-readable JSON
  --table               Output human-readable tables (default)
  --no-spinner          Disable interactive progress spinners
  --account ACCOUNT     Use an account profile for this invocation
